title: Outcome
description: What a review decided, in the one shape every host's adapter posts from: the verdict, the summary, each fresh finding on lines, the threads that are fixed, and the threads the author resolved that are not

ReviewVerdict.description: request-changes when any rule is violated, approve otherwise

Summary.description: The text of the review itself: the verdict, the count of what was probed and found, and every finding that has no line to sit on

InlineFinding.description: One finding on lines of the pull request that no thread carries yet, with its rendered text
